replace_or_add_characters_based_on_regex_match :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $1 $0) $2 $0)) (regex_split '.' $2))))))
description: A function that takes a full string, a substring to replace or add, and a substring to match using regex. It replaces or adds characters in the full string based on whether the regex match is found in the full string.

(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split empty_string $2))))))))

(lambda (lambda (replace_or_transform_substrings_based_on_delimiter $0 (lambda (regex_if (regex_match replace_vowels_with_given_characters $0) (regex_concat $0 $2) $0)))))

description: A function that appends a substring to the end of a word in a full string.
